summary: 卫星记录地表反射的不同波长，帮助农民判断同一田块哪里该多施肥或少用水。文章由精准耕作和法国案例延伸到产量预测、粮食预警及较贫穷国家的应用条件。

paragraphs.brief: 卫星为农田诊断降低成本
sentences: For farmers, working out the optimal amount of seed, fertiliser, pesticide and water to scatter on a field can make, or break, the subsequent harvest.
对农民来说，一块地该用多少种子、肥料、农药和水，拿捏得准不准，可能就决定了这一季的收成。
Regular laboratory analyses of soil and plant samples from various parts of the field can help – but such expertise is costly, and often unavailable.
定期把田间各处采集的土壤和植物样本送到实验室分析，会有帮助，但这类专业服务昂贵，也常常无处可找。
However, a new and cheaper method of doing this analysis is now on offer.
如今已有一种更便宜的新分析方法可供选择。
Precise prescriptions for growing crops can be obtained quickly, and less expensively, by calculating the amount of electromagnetic radiation reflected from agricultural land.
通过测算农田反射的电磁辐射量，可以更快、以更低成本取得精确的作物种植方案。
The data is collected by orbiting satellites.
所需数据由在轨卫星收集。
paragraphs.gist: 田间取样并请专家分析既贵又未必方便，测量卫星收到的农地电磁反射能以较低成本迅速给出更有针对性的种植建议。

paragraphs.brief: 反射波段结合天气指导种植
sentences: Examining the wavelength of the radiation that is reflected can reveal, with surprising precision, the properties of the soil, the quantity of crop being grown, and the levels in those crops of chlorophyll*, various minerals, moisture and other indicators of their quality.
分析反射辐射的波长，可以十分精确地了解土壤性质、作物生长量，以及作物中的叶绿素、各种矿物质、水分等质量指标。
If recent and forecast weather data is added to the mix, detailed maps can be produced indicating exactly how, where and when crops should be grown.
再结合近期天气记录和预报数据，就可以画出详细地图，具体指出应在何地、何时以及怎样种植作物。
The service usually costs less than US$15 per hectare for a handful of readings a year, and can increase yields by as much as 10%.
这项服务每年测量数次，每公顷的费用通常不到15美元，最多可使产量提高10%。
paragraphs.gist: 不同反射波长能揭示土壤、作物数量和叶绿素等指标，结合天气可绘制管理图，每公顷每年数次读数通常不到十五美元，产量最多可增一成。

paragraphs.brief: 法国合作社分区配肥施药
sentences: Such precision farming using satellite-based intelligence is a relatively new technique.
这种利用卫星信息的精准农业是一项比较新的技术。
Even so, it is catching on quickly.
即便如此，它也正在迅速普及。

Five times a year, for example, a French cereal-growers’ co-operative called Sevépi purchases satellite data and makes it available to its members in the form of maps of their fields, divided into three or four colour-coded zones per hectare.
例如，法国谷物种植者合作社 Sevépi 每年购买五次卫星数据，将其制成农田地图供成员使用，每公顷按颜色分成三四个区。
For each zone, one of about 50 fertiliser formulas is recommended.
每个区会从大约50种肥料配方中选取一种推荐使用。
On top of this, if the wheat in the field has already grown quite high early in the season, and heavy showers are expected, an appropriate dose of growth regulator is recommended for each zone.
另外，如果小麦在生长季初期就已长得较高，预报又有强降雨，系统就会为每个区推荐适当剂量的生长调节剂。
(Long, fragile stems break more easily in downpours.)
这是因为细长脆弱的麦秆在暴雨中更容易折断。
Then, farm vehicles equipped with global-positioning system locators automatically mix and apply the prescribed dose to each area.
随后，配有全球定位系统的农用车辆会自动调配，按推荐剂量对各区进行施用。
paragraphs.gist: 法国谷农合作社每年数次购买卫星数据，将田地分区推荐肥料与生长调节剂，再让装有GPS的农机按图自动配制和施用。

paragraphs.brief: 气候变化提高监测需求
sentences: France is the pioneer in this sort of surveillance.
法国是这种农田监测的先行者。

More farmland is analysed by satellite there than in any other country, according to Infoterra (a subsidiary of EADS Astrium), the firm that is France’s largest provider of such information, supplying data to companies such as Sevépi.
法国最大的此类数据供应商 Infoterra 是 EADS Astrium 的子公司，为 Sevépi 等机构提供数据；据其介绍，法国接受卫星分析的农田比任何其他国家都多。

Moreover, Henri Douche, head of Infoterra’s agriculture sales in Toulouse, reckons the amount of monitored farmland will increase as weather patterns change and farmers can no longer rely on the past as a guide to the future.
该公司驻图卢兹的农业销售负责人亨利·杜什认为，天气规律发生变化后，农民不能再仅凭过去判断未来，接受监测的农田还会增加。
When confounded by the yield variations that these new weather patterns will bring, even farmers who are afraid of new technology will sign up, he says.
他说，面对新天气规律造成的产量波动，即使害怕新技术的农民也会订用这项服务。
paragraphs.gist: 法国使用卫星监测的农地最多，服务商判断气候变化将使过去的经验日渐不可靠，产量波动也会促使原本排斥技术的农户采用监测。

paragraphs.brief: 监管肥料与评估歉收风险
sentences: Inexpensive data on the productivity of land is advantageous to governments, too.
政府也能从廉价的土地产能数据中受益。
Areas where fertilisers and pesticides are being applied excessively can be pinpointed, studied and regulated by environmental and land-use agencies.
环境和土地管理部门可以准确找出化肥、农药使用过量的地区，开展研究并实施监管。

Guy Lafond, an agronomist with Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, a government agency, says the satellite data it purchases is proving useful for the study of fields with declining productivity in the province of Saskatchewan.
加拿大农业与农业食品部的农艺师盖伊·拉丰说，该部门购买的卫星数据已用于研究萨斯喀彻温省产能下降的农田，效果很好。
Overkill with nitrate fertilisers (which are also a source of greenhouse gases) appears partly responsible.
硝酸盐肥料施用过量似乎是部分原因，这类肥料也是温室气体的来源之一。

And according to RapidEye, a German satellite operator, insurance companies are also studying satellite data with a view to selling insurance policies to governments of famine-prone countries that might be threatened by crop failure.
据德国卫星运营商 RapidEye 介绍，保险公司也在研究卫星数据，希望向易受饥荒影响、可能面临作物歉收的国家政府出售保险。
paragraphs.gist: 廉价数据也能帮助政府找出施肥过度的农地，加拿大用来研究减产原因，保险公司则研究用它评估易遭歉收国家的风险。

paragraphs.brief: 红边波段监测细分地块
sentences: In March, RapidEye began selling data that helps forecast harvests.
当年三月，RapidEye 开始出售可帮助预测收成的数据。
‘Too often, farmers limit productivity by managing fields uniformly,’ says Fredrick Jung-Rothenhaüsler, head of product development at the firm’s headquarters in Brandenburg an der Havel.
该公司在哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡总部的产品开发负责人表示：“农民常常对整块田一律采用同样的管理方法，反而限制了产量。”
‘Our satellites are the first commercial satellites to include the Red-Edge band of the light spectrum, which is sensitive to changes in chlorophyll content.
“我们的卫星是首批配备红边波段的商用卫星，这个光谱波段对叶绿素含量变化很敏感。
More research will be necessary to realise the full potential of the Red-Edge band.
要充分发挥红边波段的潜力，还需更多研究。
However, this band can assist in monitoring vegetation health, improving species separation and also help in measuring protein and nitrogen content in biomass.’
不过，它已可用于监测植被健康、更好地区分物种，也有助于测量生物质中的蛋白质和氮含量。”
The company’s data, which comes from both Europe and the Americas, breaks field productivity down into patches just five metres square.
这家公司收集欧洲和美洲的数据，可以将农田的生产力细分到边长仅五米的方形小区。
paragraphs.gist: RapidEye用对叶绿素敏感的红边波段监测作物，能区分植被、估计蛋白质及氮含量，并把同一块田细分到五米见方。

paragraphs.brief: 非洲土样与免费数字土壤图
sentences: The advantages that satellite technology provides in terms of precision farming do not have to be restricted to rich countries.
卫星技术给精准农业带来的好处，也能惠及富国以外的地方。
In Africa, where many soils have become badly depleted of nutrients, better fertiliser management would greatly improve the situation.
非洲许多地方的土壤养分已严重流失，改善施肥管理可以显著缓解这一问题。

As a consequence, the charitable trust World Agroforestry Centre, in the city of Nairobi, in Kenya, has begun to build up a catalogue of the radiation patterns derived from around 100,000 samples of African soils.
为此，位于肯尼亚内罗毕的慈善机构世界农林中心已开始汇编约十万份非洲土壤样本的辐射特征。
The information is the key to understanding the potential of these soils to be more agriculturally productive.
这些资料有助于判断当地土壤还有多大的农业增产潜力。
Once passed on to the International Centre for Tropical Agriculture, based in Colombia, South America, it is intended that the information be used to build a database called the ‘Digital Soil Map’.
按计划，资料将交给位于南美洲哥伦比亚的国际热带农业中心，用于建立一个名为“数字土壤地图”的数据库。
When ready, this will provide farmers with free forecasts, developed with regularly updated satellite imagery, across farmland in a number of countries in Africa.
数据库建成后，会借助定期更新的卫星影像，为非洲多个国家的农田提供免费预测。
This is information which will almost certainly assist in improving crop yields.
这些信息几乎肯定能帮助农民提高产量。
For a hunger-ravaged continent, that is good news indeed.
对一个饱受饥饿之苦的大陆而言，这的确是好消息。
paragraphs.gist: 为让非洲农民也享有精细施肥信息，研究团队汇集约十万份土样的辐射特征，拟结合持续更新的卫星影像提供免费的土壤预测。

items.en: an example of how farmers in one country are now using satellite data to determine fertiliser use
items.zh: 一国农民利用卫星数据决定如何施肥的实例。
items.why: 法国合作社把卫星图划分为不同区域，并对各区推荐不同肥料配方，是实际施肥决策案例。

items.en: a reference to climate change and its effects
items.zh: 提到气候变化及其影响
items.why: 题干是“气候变化及影响”。这里用“weather patterns change” 表达“气候/天气规律改变”,并给出影响: 过去经验失效 + 产量波动。

items.en: a reference to the effect on the soil of using too much fertiliser
items.zh: 提到使用太多化肥对土壤的影响
items.why: 加拿大农田生产力下降，文中指出过量施用硝酸盐肥料似乎是部分原因；其他段落中的矿物质或水分只是监测指标。

items.en: an example of information that will be shared between different countries
items.zh: 将在不同国家之间共享信息的范例
items.why: 资料拟传给位于哥伦比亚的国际热带农业中心建库，说明信息将跨国共享。

items.en: a mention of the country which is the leader in agricultural technology
items.zh: 提到农业技术领先的国家
items.why: D段直接称法国是这种农业遥感监测的先行者，随后以受监测农田面积居首作说明。

items.en: a description of an innovation in satellite imaging which requires further study
items.zh: 对一项仍需进一步研究的卫星成像创新的描述。
items.why: 商用卫星首次采用对叶绿素变化敏感的红边波段。研究人员同时指出，要发挥这一波段的全部潜力仍需进一步研究。

items.en: evidence of the cost effectiveness of using satellite technology in agriculture
items.zh: 将卫星技术用于农业能够以较低成本取得良好成效的证据。
items.why: B 段同时给出成本和收益：每年测量数次，每公顷通常不到15美元，产量最高可增加10%。

items.en: Which TWO companies obtain information directly from satellites?
items.zh: 哪两家公司直接从卫星取得信息？

items.en: Initially, orbiting satellites are used to measure ________coming from farmland.
items.zh: 首先用在轨卫星测量来自农田的________。
items.why: 答案必须直接取词: electromagnetic radiation (两词) 最稳。

items.en: ________believes that confusion about irregular weather will cause more farmers to use satellite technology.
items.zh: ________认为，难以预测的天气会使更多农民开始使用卫星技术。

items.en: As a result of satellite technology, it may become possible to insure against the risk of ________
items.zh: 借助卫星技术，今后或许可以为________带来的风险投保。
items.why: 定位句说：“据德国卫星运营商 RapidEye 介绍，保险公司也在研究卫星数据，希望向易受饥荒影响、可能面临作物歉收的国家政府出售保险。”

items.en: In Africa, much of the soil suffers from the loss of ________
items.zh: 在非洲，大量土壤因失去________而受损。
items.why: “loss” 在文中用“depleted”表达，答案取名词 nutrients。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

pairs: overkill 表示做过了头，在本文特指过量使用硝酸盐肥料。
题干说信号来自农田，原文进一步说明卫星检测到的是农田反射的辐射。
points: 题干是“气候变化及影响”。这里用“weather patterns change” 表达“气候/天气规律改变”,并给出影响: 过去经验失效 + 产量波动。
“loss” 在文中用“depleted”表达，答案取名词 nutrients。
clauses: …, detailed maps can be produced indicating exactly how, where and when crops should be grown.
连接词 if 引出“If recent and forecast weather data is added to the mix”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
Areas … can be pinpointed, studied and regulated by environmental and land-use agencies.
“where fertilisers and pesticides are being applied excessively”修饰前面的 Areas。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 where 时，回看 Areas，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Satellite technology is helping farmers boost crop yields
卫星技术帮助农民提高作物产量
